context_requirements: Active glycoprotein folding and N-linked glycosylation in the ER
Functional ER stress / unfolded protein response signaling
Cellular uptake or exposure to the inhibitor at 10 micromolar
For GAA/GANAB/GANC inhibition, expression of the corresponding ER glucosidases
falsifiers: No change in ER stress/UPR landmark genes (e.g., DDIT4, CHAC1, TRIB3, HERPUD1, XBP1) at 24 h in any cell line
No coordinated decrease in cholesterol biosynthesis genes at 24 h
Transcriptional response indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines
Strong, rapid (6 h) and broad transcriptional changes inconsistent with slow ER stress kinetics
